newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 22.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Private firms will have to pay pensions to nationals; draft law being formulated by Ministry of Finance and Industry.
- UAE protests Iran building a pier on Greater Tunb island, at the centre of a dispute between the two countries.
- UAE patents law to be amended in a bid to comply with global trade standards.
- Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank gets overwhelming response from investors on the first day it opened for subscription.
- UAE and Germany sign investment protection agreement.
- UAE informs United Nations of violations by Iran on disputed islands.
- Chemical plants increase production in UAE with 60 percent of output being exported.
